domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by a third-party-logistics warehouse's client billing schedule: pallet stock on hand, anniversary storage weeks, long-stay storage tiers, per-pallet handling with out-of-hours rates, client rate cards in force by date, minimum storage fees, peak stock and an energy surcharge on billed storage, with returns to stock keyed against lots. The deliverable is the warehouse's client statement, a supply-chain operations artifact; code is the medium, not the subject.
evidence: instruction.md: symptoms are client billing queries about storage weeks, tiers, handling, holidays, rate cards, peak stock and energy surcharges
environment/app/docs/billing-schedule.md: a numbered warehouse billing schedule (on hand, anniversary storage weeks, tiers, minimum fee, peak, handling, rate cards in force, energy surcharge)
planned verifier: whole-statement comparison of every lot's figures and the total against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, derived from the schedule
task.toml: Operations / Supply chain, tags supply-chain / third-party-logistics / warehouse-billing
novelty_note: Replaces tbrain-container-demurrage-detention after the orchestrator's ruling. No free-time-then-daily-rate structure: storage is anniversary-weekly per pallet with tiers by week number; handling per movement. Not one of the blueprint's accepted settings (the closest, moving-average inventory close, is stock valuation, not warehouse service billing). mined-candidates/index.jsonl is absent locally, so the miner dedupe could not run.
